_comment: Per-scenario expected detection signatures. Source of truth: experiment/scenario-inventory.md. Used by score_results.py to classify each (scenario, group, rule) cell with the 4-state taxonomy (DETECTED / RULE_MISSED / DATA_MISSED / NOT_OBSERVABLE) plus a 5th process-level state (UNEXPECTED_FIRING) for review.

_taxonomy.DETECTED: Rule fired correctly on the captured log (count matches expectation).
_taxonomy.RULE_MISSED: Predicted to fire but didn't — rule weakness.
_taxonomy.DATA_MISSED: Predicted to fire but the captured data didn't include what the rule needed — capture-tool weakness.
_taxonomy.NOT_OBSERVABLE: Never expected to fire at this transport layer (architectural blind spot).
_taxonomy.NOT_EXPECTED: Not in the predicted firing set; absence is correct. (Cell omitted from main paper table; included here for completeness.)
_taxonomy.UNEXPECTED_FIRING: Fired without prediction. Review needed: either upgrade to corrected prediction or flag as false positive.

_count_semantics: actual >= expected → DETECTED. actual < expected → RULE_MISSED. actual > expected → DETECTED with notes column flag.

_visibility_overrides._comment: Rules that are NOT_OBSERVABLE in specific groups regardless of scenario.
